Iska kaam isliye zaroori tha ki prashant mahasagar ke chhote dweep deshon ko samudri, kheti tatha swasthya ke adhyayan akele nahi mil sakte the; isliye ek saanjhi vigyanik sanstha banayi gayi jo saikdon dweep deshon ke liye aankda aur salaah deti hai. Honolulu, Port Moresby tatha Suva kshetra ke bade sheher hain tatha PIF ka daftar Suva mein hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: SPC ka daftar Noumea mein hai - yahi prashant dweep deshon ke adhyayan tatha salaah ka kendra hai.

qe: Where is the headquarters of the 'International Coffee Organization' (ICO) located?
qh: 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय कॉफी संगठन' (ICO) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: International Coffee Organization (ICO) ka daftar London mein hai tatha yah 1962 mein kofi ke kharid-daam ko sambhalne ke liye bani thi. Yah sheher isliye chuna gaya ki London bade paryavasi tatha vyapar ke kendra raha hai tatha wahan kofi ke aayatan tatha dam ke aankde aasaani se jama hote hain; isliye ugane wale deshon ko sahi dam tatha bazaar ki jankari milti hai. Brasilia, Nairobi tatha Bogota bade kofi ugane wale deshon ke sheher hain par ICO ka daftar wahan nahi hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: ICO ka daftar London mein hai - yahi kofi ke vyapar tatha dam ki nigrani karti hai.

qe: The 'Arctic Council' secretariat is located in which city?
qh: 'आर्कटिक परिषद' का सचिवालय किस शहर में स्थित है?
e: Arctic Council ka sachivalay Norway ke sheher Tromso mein hai tatha iske aath sadasya desh hain jo Arctic kshetra se lage hue hain. Yah daftar isliye chuna gaya ki Tromso Arctic ke sabse nazdeek badi aabadi wala sheher hai, isliye barf pighalne, jahazraani tatha paryavaran ke muddon par vaigyanik adhyayan ka saara saaman wahin se aasaani se bheja ja sakta hai. Oslo, Reykjavik tatha Anchorage bhi Arctic ke kshetra ke sheher hain par sachivalay Tromso mein hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Arctic Council ka sachivalay Tromso mein hai - yahi Arctic ke aath deshon ka saanjha manch hai.

qe: Where is the headquarters of the 'International Grains Council' (IGC) located?
qh: 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अनाज परिषद' (IGC) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: International Grains Council (IGC) ka daftar London mein hai tatha yahi anaj ke bazaar ki halat par Grain Market Report nikaalti hai. Yah sangh isliye bana ki gehu tatha anya anaj ka daam deshon mein sangharsh tatha aakaal ka bada karan hota hai, isliye ek jagah par saare aankde jama hokar niti banane walon ko pehle se pata chal jaata hai ki bazaar kahan ja raha hai. Winnipeg tatha Chicago bade anaj ke bazaar tatha exchange hain tatha Paris mein anya sansthaon ka daftar hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: IGC ka daftar London mein hai - yahi anaj ke vaishvik vyapar ka aankda rakhti hai.

qe: Which international body regulates 'Antarctic' activities under the Antarctic Treaty?
qh: कौन सा अंतर्राष्ट्रीय निकाय 'अंटार्कटिक' गतिविधियों को नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Antarctic ki gativihiyon ko Antarctic Treaty Secretariat (ATS) dekhta hai tatha yah sachivalay Argentina ki rajdhani Buenos Aires mein hai. Yah vyavastha isliye bani ki Antarctica par kisi ek desh ka daav na chale tatha wahan keval shaanti tatha vigyan ka kaam ho; isliye 1959 ke samjhauta ke antargat khanan par rok, saikdon ke adhyayan tatha parivesh suraksha ke niyam sachivalay se chalte hain. UN General Assembly ka yah alag kshetriya vyavastha hai, Greenpeace ek niji sanstha hai tatha IUCN jeevon ki soochi banati hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Antarctica ki gativihiyon ka niyantran ATS karta hai - iska sachivalay Buenos Aires mein hai.

qe: Where is the headquarters of 'UNRWA' (UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees) located?
qh: 'UNRWA' का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: UNRWA ka daftar Amman tatha Gaza City dono sthaanon par chalta hai, isliye combined sthaan wala vikalp sahi hai. Yah sanstha isliye 1949 mein bani ki vibhajan ke baad bade sankhya mein failistini sharnarthi ghar se beghar ho gaye the, isliye unhe khaana, skool tatha swasthya ki suvidha pahunchane ke liye ek alag nikaay banaya gaya. Cairo tatha Beirut kshetra ke bade sheher hain tatha Jerusalem ko anya daftaron ke liye maana jaata hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: UNRWA ka daftar Amman tatha Gaza City mein hai - yahi failistini sharnarthiyon ki madad karta hai.

qe: The 'Bureau International des Poids et Mesures' (BIPM) is located in?
qh: 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय भार एवं माप ब्यूरो' (BIPM) कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures (BIPM) France ke sheher Sevres mein hai jo Paris ke bilkul nazdeek hai, isliye Sevres wala vikalp sahi hai. Yah daftar isliye wahan rakha gaya ki 1875 ke metre samjhauta ke baad naap ke saare etalon ek safe jagah rakhne the, isliye second, metre tatha kilogram ki saanjhi paribhasha aaj bhi wahin sambhalti hai. Vienna, Geneva tatha London ke daftar anya sansthaon ke hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: BIPM Sevres (Paris ke paas) mein hai - yahi duniya bhar ki naap tatha wazan ka etalon rakhta hai.

qe: Which organization issues the 'World Population Prospects' report?
qh: 'विश्व जनसंख्या संभावना' रिपोर्ट कौन सा संगठन जारी करता है?
e: World Population Prospects report UN DESA ki Population Division nikaalti hai, isliye yahi sahi uttar hai. Yah report isliye ahem hai ki ismein har desh ki jansankhya, umar ka anupaat tatha aage ka anuman hota hai, isliye saikdon sarkaron tatha sansthaon ko apni niti banane mein sahi aankda milta hai. UNICEF bachchon ke aankde deta hai, WHO sehat ke aankde deta hai tatha UNDP manav vikas report nikaalti hai, isliye ye teeno is report ke sahi naam nahi hain. Exam point: World Population Prospects report UN DESA ki Population Division nikaalti hai - yahi jansankhya ka vaishvik anuman deti hai.

qe: Where is the headquarters of the 'International Organization for Migration' (IOM)?
qh: 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रवासन संगठन' (IOM) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: International Organization for Migration (IOM) ka daftar Geneva mein hai tatha yah 1951 mein yuddh ke baad logon ko bhejne-pahunchane ke liye bani thi. Yah sheher isliye chuna gaya ki Geneva mein sharnarthi tatha pravasiyon ke liye kaam karne wali kai sansthaen pehle se maujood thi, isliye pravasan ke kanoon tatha logon ki suvidhaon par kaam ek jagah se aasan hua; 2016 se yah United Nations se juda sanstha hai. New York, Vienna tatha Brussels ke daftar mukhya sansthaon ke hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: IOM ka daftar Geneva mein hai - yahi pravasiyon ki suvidha tatha pravasan ke niyamon par kaam karta hai.

qe: The 'Islamic Development Bank' (IsDB) is headquartered in which city?
qh: 'इस्लामी विकास बैंक' (IsDB) का मुख्यालय किस शहर में है?
e: Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) ka daftar Saudi Arabia ke sheher Jeddah mein hai tatha yah 1975 mein bani thi. Yah bank isliye khada hua ki uske sadasya deshon ko shariyat ke niyamon ke hisaab se tatha bina byaj ke paisa chahiye tha; isliye yah bade adhaar-bhoomi tatha udyog pariyojnaon mein sahyog deta hai tatha iske 57 sadasya desh hain. Riyadh tatha Istanbul sadasya deshon ke sheher hain tatha Dubai vyapar ka kendra hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: IsDB ka daftar Jeddah mein hai - yahi musalman deshon ka bank hai jo bina byaj ke karz deta hai.

qe: Where is the headquarters of 'CERN' (European Organization for Nuclear Research) located?
qh: 'सर्न' (CERN) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: CERN ka daftar Switzerland ke sheher Geneva mein hai tatha yah 1954 mein Europe ke deshon ne shaanti ke samay vigyan par kaam karne ke liye banaya tha. Yah jagah isliye chuni gayi ki France ki seema ke paas zameen tatha paisa aasaani se mila tatha Geneva shaanti ka kendra tha; isliye yahan duniya ka sabse bada quark-machine (LHC) bana jahan protonon ko takra kar naye kaarun dhoonde jaate hain. Berlin tatha Zurich bade vigyan ke kendra hain tatha Paris mein kai sansthaon ka daftar hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: CERN ka daftar Geneva mein hai - yahi duniya ka sabse bada particle takraav wala kendra hai.

qe: Where is the headquarters of the 'Common Fund for Commodities' (CFC)?
qh: 'कॉमन फंड फॉर कमोडिटीज' (CFC) का मुख्यालय कहाँ है?
e: Common Fund for Commodities (CFC) ka daftar Netherlands ke sheher Amsterdam mein hai tatha yah 1989 mein bana tha. Yah kosh isliye khada hua ki chai, kapaas tatha tamaku jaisi cheezon ke daam girakar ugane wale desh barbaad ho jaate the, isliye ek saanjha kosh banaya gaya jo aise deshon ki kheti tatha udyog ko sambhalta hai. Geneva, Brussels tatha London ke daftar anya sansthaon ke hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: CFC ka daftar Amsterdam mein hai - yahi kheti ki cheezon ke daam girne par ugane wale deshon ki madad karta hai.

qe: Which international group was established under the framework of the 'Lomé Convention'?
qh: 'लोम कन्वेंशन' द्वारा किस अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संगठन (या साझेदारी) की स्थापना की गई थी?
e: Lome Convention se African, Caribbean and Pacific (ACP) Group bani thi, isliye yahi sahi naam hai; yah 1975 mein Togo ke sheher Lome mein hua tha. Yah samjhauta isliye bana ki Europe ke purane upnivesh hone wale deshon ko apni kheti ki cheezein Europe mein bina bhaari kar ke bechne ki chhoot chahiye thi, isliye unhe sabse pehle aage rakhne ka haq mila; aage chal kar yah Cotonou tatha Samoa samjhauta bante gaye. African Union, OPEC tatha European Union alag raja-netik sansthaen hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Lome Convention se ACP Group bani thi - yahi Europe tatha uske purane upniveshon ke deshon ka vyapar manch hai.

qe: Where is the headquarters of the 'International Rubber Study Group' (IRSG) located?
qh: 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय रबर अध्ययन समूह' (IRSG) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: International Rubber Study Group (IRSG) ka daftar Singapore mein hai tatha yah sarkari sansthaon ka manch hai jo rabar ke bazaar ka aankda rakhta hai. Yah sheher isliye chuna gaya ki Singapore samudri vyapar tatha rabar ke aayat-niryat ka bada kendra hai, isliye ugane wale deshon ko dam tatha bhandar ki jankari wahin se aasaani se milti hai. Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta tatha Bangkok bade rabar ugane wale deshon ke sheher hain par IRSG ka daftar Singapore mein hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: IRSG ka daftar Singapore mein hai - yahi rabar ke vyapar tatha bazaar ki soochna rakhta hai.

qe: The 'Eurasian Economic Union' (EAEU) commission is headquartered in which city?
qh: 'यूरेशियन आर्थिक संघ' (EAEU) का मुख्यालय किस शहर में है?
e: Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) ka daftar Russia ki rajdhani Moscow mein hai tatha yah 2015 mein kaam karne laga tha. Yah sangh isliye bana ki soviet sangh ke bikhne ke baad bane deshon ke beech vyapar tatha vaahan aapas mein bina rukavat chale; isliye Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Armenia tatha Kyrgyzstan milkar ek saanjhi bazaar banate hain tatha naye deshon ko bhi shamil hone ka avsar rakha gaya hai. Minsk, Astana tatha Yerevan sadasya deshon ke sheher hain par daftar Moscow mein hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: EAEU ka daftar Moscow mein hai - yahi Russia tatha uske padosi deshon ka saanjha bazaar hai.

qe: Where is the headquarters of the 'International Lead and Zinc Study Group' (ILZSG) located?
qh: 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सीसा और जस्ता अध्ययन समूह' (ILZSG) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Sisa tatha jaste ke adhyayan samuh (ILZSG) ka daftar Portugal ki rajdhani Lisbon mein hai tatha yah sarkari sansthaon ka manch hai jo in dhaatuon ke utpadan tatha dam ka lekhajokha rakhta hai. Lisbon ko yahi daftar isliye mila ki yah sheher saikdon saal se samudri vyapar tatha atalantik vyapar ka kendra hai tatha wahan se Europe tatha anya mahadeepon ke bazar ki jankari ekatr karne mein suvidha rahti hai. Madrid, London tatha Geneva anya sansthaon ke kendra hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: ILZSG ka daftar Lisbon mein hai - yahi sisa tatha jaste ke bazar ka aankda rakhta hai.

qe: The 'Southern African Development Community' (SADC) is headquartered in?
qh: 'दक्षिणी अफ्रीकी विकास समुदाय' (SADC) का मुख्यालय कहाँ है?
e: Dakshini Afriki Vikas Samuday (SADC) ka daftar Botswana ki rajdhani Gaborone mein hai tatha yah 1992 mein Windhoek samjhauta se bana tha. Yah manch isliye khada hua ki dakshini Africa ke desh apartid tatha upnivesh ke baad apni vyapar tatha suraksha ki niti akele nahi bana sakte the; isliye kheti, khanan tatha bijli ke saanjhe karyakram yahin se chalte hain. Johannesburg tatha Pretoria dakshini Africa ke sheher hain tatha Lusaka sadasya desh ki rajdhani hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: SADC ka daftar Gaborone mein hai tatha yah dakshini Africa ke deshon ka saanjha manch hai.

qe: Where is the headquarters of the 'International Cocoa Organization' (ICCO) located?
qh: 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय कोको संगठन' (ICCO) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Antarrashtriya Cocoa Sangathan (ICCO) ka daftar Cote d'Ivoire ki rajdhani Abidjan mein hai tatha yah cocoa ke utpadan tatha dam par nazar rakhti hai. Yah sheher isliye chuna gaya ki duniya ka sabse bada cocoa ugane wala desh yahi hai, isliye ugane wale chhote kisaanon ki samasya tatha bazar ki jankari wahin se sabse pehle pahunchti hai. London tatha Geneva doosri sansthaon ke daftar rakhte hain tatha Accra cocoa ke kshetra ka purana sheher hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: ICCO ka daftar Abidjan mein hai - yahi cocoa ki kheti tatha dam ki nigrani karti hai.

qe: Which organization issues the 'World Employment and Social Outlook' report?
qh: 'विश्व रोजगार और सामाजिक आउटलुक' रिपोर्ट कौन सा संगठन जारी करता है?
e: 'Vishw Rojgar aur Samajik Aautlook' report ILO nikaalti hai, isliye yahi sahi sanstha hai. Ismein duniya bhar mein naukari, berojgari tatha mazdoori ke sath-sath anyay tatha samajik suraksha ki sthiti ek hi jagah milti hai; isliye sarkaron ko rozgar ki niti banane mein sahi aankda milta hai. IMF mudra ke aankde deta hai, UNDP manav vikas report nikaalti hai tatha World Bank vikas ke aankde jama karta hai, isliye ye teeno is report ke sahi nam nahi hain. Exam point: World Employment and Social Outlook report ILO nikaalti hai - ismein rozgar tatha mazdoori ki sthiti hoti hai.

qe: Where is the headquarters of the 'Inter-Parliamentary Union' (IPU) located?
qh: 'अंतर-संसदीय संघ' (IPU) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Antarrashtriya Sansadiya Sangh (IPU) ka daftar Geneva mein hai tatha yah 1889 mein bana tha, isliye yahi sahi sthaan hai. Yah sanstha isliye khadi hui ki alag-alag deshon ke vidhayakon ko apas mein baat-cheet ka manch chahiye tha, isliye sansadon ke sath milkar loka-tantra tatha shaanti ke liye kaam hota hai. Washington D.C., Paris tatha Brussels ke daftar anya sansthaon ke hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: IPU ka daftar Geneva mein hai - yahi duniya bhar ke sansadon ka saanjha manch hai.

qe: The 'Central American Integration System' (SICA) is headquartered in?
qh: 'मध्य अमेरिकी एकीकरण प्रणाली' (SICA) का मुख्यालय कहाँ है?
e: Madhya Ameriki Ekikaran Pranali (SICA) ka daftar El Salvador ki rajdhani San Salvador mein hai tatha yah 1991 mein bani thi. Yah manch isliye khada hua ki chhote madhya ameriki deshon ke liye akele chalna mushkil tha; isliye seema-shul, vyapar tatha prakop (hurricane) ke samay bachav ke kaam saanjhe taur par hote hain. San Jose tatha Panama City kshetra ke bade sheher hain tatha Guatemala City sadasya desh ki rajdhani hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: SICA ka daftar San Salvador mein hai - yahi madhya ameriki deshon ka ekikaran manch hai.

qe: Where is the headquarters of 'UN-Habitat' located?
qh: 'यूएन-हैबिटेट' (UN-Habitat) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: UN-Habitat bhi Nairobi se chalne wali sanstha hai tatha yah sheheron tatha kachchi bastiyon ke vikas par kaam karta hai. Yah jagah isliye chuna gaya ki vikas karne wale deshon mein tezi se badhti aabadi tatha kachchi bastiyon ki samasya sabse zyada hai, isliye wahin se sabse pehle sasta ghar, saaf pani tatha nikaasi ke karyakram banaye jaate hain. Paris, New York tatha Geneva ke daftar anya sansthaon ke hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: UN-Habitat ka daftar Nairobi mein hai - yahi sheheron mein sab ke liye ghar tatha suvidha ka kaam dekhta hai.

qe: In which city is the headquarters of 'ASEAN' located?
qh: 'आसियान' (ASEAN) का मुख्यालय किस शहर में स्थित है?
e: ASEAN ka sachivalay Indonesia ki rajdhani Jakarta mein hai tatha yah 1967 mein Bangkok sanket se shuru hua tha. Yah sheher isliye mila ki Indonesia kshetra ka sabse bada desh hai tatha Jakarta mein sabdiplomati daftar pehle se the, isliye vyapar tatha suraksha ki baat-cheet wahin se asani se hoti hai. Hanoi, Manila tatha Bangkok sadasya deshon ke sheher hain par ASEAN ka daftar Jakarta mein hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: ASEAN ka daftar Jakarta mein hai - yahi dakshin-purv eshiyai deshon ka manch hai.

qe: What is a 'Sovereign Wealth Fund' (SWF)?
qh: 'सॉवरेन वेल्थ फंड' (SWF) क्या है?
o: A personal fund of the Head of State
A state-owned investment fund that invests surplus reserves in global assets for returns
A charitable trust for disaster recovery
e: Rajya-swami sampatti kosh (Sovereign Wealth Fund) vesa sarkar ka apna nivesh kosh hota hai jo videshi marzi ki adhik (surplus) sampatti ko vaishvik sampattiyon mein lagakar laabh kamata hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah kosh isliye bana ki tel, gas tatha khanan se mili daulat se aane wali kamai kuch saal mein khatam ho jayegi, isliye aise kosh se ane wale deshon ki aane wali peedhi ko bachaya jaata hai; Norway, Saudi Arabia tatha Singapore ke kosh isi tarah chalte hain. Rajya ke mukhiya ka niji kosh, garibon ki bahi-khata tatha aapda trust ye teeno SWF nahi hote, isliye wo alag vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Sovereign Wealth Fund sarkar ka nivesh kosh hota hai - yahi bachai hui kamai ko vaishvik sampattiyon mein lagata hai.

qe: What is the primary difference between 'Multilateral' and 'Regional' trade agreements?
qh: 'बहुपक्षीय' (Multilateral) और 'क्षेत्रीय' (Regional) व्यापार समझौतों के बीच प्राथमिक अंतर क्या है?
o: Multilateral involves multiple global partners under common rules; Regional focuses on a specific geographic bloc
Regional is global across all continents; Multilateral is strictly bilateral
Regional agreements exclude tariff reductions completely
Multilateral agreements deal only with barter trade
e: Bahupakshiya (Multilateral) samjhauta duniya ke kai deshon ke liye ek jaise niyam banaata hai, jabki kshetriya (Regional) samjhauta ek hi bhugol kshetra ke deshon ke beech hota hai, isliye pehli vyakhya sahi hai. Yah antar isliye mahatvapurn hai ki WTO ke bahupakshiya niyam sabhi sadasya deshon par bina bhedbhav lagte hain tatha vivaad ki sunvai bhi usi manch par hoti hai; jabki kshetriya (Regional) samjhauta mein sadasya desh apne beech chalne wali chhoot tatha tarifa khud tay karte hain. Shetra ko sabhi mahadeepon mein phailana, tarifa ghatana tatha keval bartar vyapar ka daawa karne wale teeno bayan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: bahupakshiya niyam sabhi ke liye ek jaise hote hain tatha kshetriya (Regional) samjhauta ek kshetra ke deshon ke beech hota hai.

qe: Which historic conference led to the establishment of the IMF and the World Bank in 1944?
qh: 1944 में किस सम्मेलन के कारण IMF और विश्व बैंक की स्थापना हुई थी?
e: Bretton Woods Samelan 1944 ke karan IMF tatha World Bank banaye gaye the, isliye yahi sahi uttar hai. Yah samelan isliye bulaya gaya ki do bisw yuddhon tatha maha-mandi ke baad duniya ki arthavyavastha bikhar chuki thi; isliye deshon ne New Hampshire (America) ke Bretchton Woods mein milkar aise niyam tay kiye jo bhugtan santulan tatha yuddh ke baad punarnirmaan mein madad karein. Paris Peace Conference, San Francisco Conference tatha Vienna Conference anya samay ke manch the, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: 1944 ke Bretton Woods Samelan se IMF tatha World Bank ki neev padi - isliye dono ko Bretton Woods sansthaen kaha jaata hai.

qe: What is the primary purpose of the IMF providing balance of payments financing to members?
qh: सदस्य देशों को ऋण प्रदान करने का IMF का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To provide short-term balance of payments support and stabilize foreign exchange
To manage sovereign debt write-offs completely
e: IMF ka mukhya uddeshya sadasya deshon ko chhoti avadhi ke bhugtan santulan ke sankat mein madad dena tatha videshi mudra ki sthirta banaye rakhna hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah kaam isliye zaroori hai ki jab kisi desh ka aayatan niryatan se zyada ho jaye tatha uski mudra girne lage, tab duniya ka vyapar tatha nivesh bhi ruk jaata hai; isliye IMF karz dekar sudhar ke saath desh ko sambhalta hai. Aam upbhokta vastuon par subsidy dena, lambi avadhi ke adhara-bhumi nirmaan ka paisa dena tatha karjon ko poori tarah maf karna, ye teeno uske kaam nahi hain. Exam point: IMF chhoti avadhi ke bhugtan santulan ke liye karz deta hai - lambi avadhi ke nirmaan ke liye World Bank hai.

qe: Which currency was added to the IMF's SDR valuation basket in October 2016?
qh: अक्टूबर 2016 में SDR बास्केट में किस मुद्रा को जोड़ा गया था?
e: October 2016 mein SDR basket mein Chinese Renminbi (Yuan) ko shamil kiya gaya tha, isliye yahi sahi uttar hai. SDR yani Special Drawing Rights IMF ka ek kalpanik akaunta hai jise sadasya desh apni mudra ke bhugtan ke liye istemal kar sakte hain; isliye jab China ki arthavyavastha tatha vyapar bada hone laga tab uski mudra bhi basket ke pach bade namson (Dollar, Euro, Pound, Yen tatha Yuan) mein jud gayi. Russian Ruble, Indian Rupee tatha Swiss Franc SDR basket mein nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: 2016 mein Renminbi SDR basket mein juda - isse China ki mudra ki bhumika vaishvik ho gayi.

qe: What determines a member country's financial quota and voting power in the IMF?
qh: IMF में किसी सदस्य देश का 'कोटा' और मतदान शक्ति क्या निर्धारित करती है?
o: Its relative economic size, openness, variability, and international reserves
e: IMF mein sadasya desh ka kota tatha matdan shakti uski aarthik aakar, khulepan, ashtirata tatha videshi bhandaar par nirbhar karti hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah niyam isliye chal pada ki jitana bada desh IMF ke kosh mein paisa daalta hai, utna hi uske faislon mein bolne ka adhikar hona chahiye; isliye jis desh ka kota zyada hota hai, use utna hi karz tatha SDR bhi mil sakta hai. Sainik kharch, zameen ka kshetra tatha jansankhya keval aadhe sach hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: IMF mein kota aarthik aakar tatha khulepan se tay hota hai - wahi matadan shakti tatha karz ki seema tay karta hai.

qe: What portion of an IMF member's quota subscription must be paid in reserve assets (SDRs or widely accepted currencies)?
qh: IMF कोटे का कितना हिस्सा आरक्षित संपत्तियों (जैसे SDR या प्रमुख मुद्राओं) में चुकाना आवश्यक होता है?
e: IMF ke kote ka 25 pratishat hissa aarakshit sampattiyon (SDR ya pramukh mudraon) mein dena zaroori hota hai, isliye 25% wala vikalp sahi hai. Yah niyam isliye bana ki IMF ke paas duniya bhar ke sankat mein turant kam aane wali kam se kam ek chauthai punji honi chahiye; baaki hissa apni desh ki mudra mein dena hota hai. 100%, 50% tatha 10% wale vikalp is niyam se alag hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: IMF kote ka 25 pratishat aarakshit sampattion mein dena hota hai - yahi kosh ka turant istemal yogya hissa hai.

qe: Which arm of the World Bank Group is known as the 'Soft Loan Window' for the world's poorest nations?
qh: विश्व बैंक समूह की किस शाखा को 'सॉफ्ट लोन विंडो' के रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: World Bank samuh ki shakha IDA ko 'soft loan window' kaha jaata hai, isliye yahi sahi nam hai. IDA garib deshon ko bina-byaj ya bahut kam byaj ke tatha lambi avadhi ke liye karz deti hai, kyonki aise deshon ki arthavyavastha aur ay chhoti hoti hai; isliye sehat, padhai tatha saaf pani jaise kaam wahan se chalaye jaate hain. ICSID nivesh vivadon ka nirnay karta hai, IFC niji kshetra ko paisa deta hai tatha MIGA risk bima deti hai, isliye ye teeno is shakha ke sahi nam nahi hain. Exam point: IDA ko soft loan window kaha jaata hai - yahi garib deshon ko saste tatha lambi avadhi ke karz deti hai.

qe: The 'International Finance Corporation' (IFC), a World Bank Group member, focuses exclusively on:
qh: विश्व बैंक समूह का सदस्य 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय वित्त निगम' (IFC) मुख्य रूप से किस पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है?
o: Promoting private sector enterprise and commercial investment in developing nations
e: International Finance Corporation (IFC) vikas karne wale deshon mein niji kshetra tatha vyaparik nivesh ko badhane par dhyan deti hai, isliye yahi sahi kam hai. Yah shakha isliye bani ki sarkari karz se har zarurat poori nahi hoti; isliye IFC companyon mein hissa lekar ya karz dekar unhe khada karne mein madad karti hai, jisse rozgar tatha naye kaam-dhandhe badhte hain. Keval sarkari sarkaron ko karz dena IBRD ka kaam hai, samudri seema ke jhagde suljhana alag manch ka kaam hai tatha sampatti adhikaron ki treati WIPO dekhti hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: IFC niji kshetra tatha vyaparik nivesh par dhyan deti hai - yahi companyon mein hissa lagati hai.

qe: Who served as the inaugural President of the New Development Bank (NDB)?
qh: न्यू डेवलपमेंट बैंक (NDB) के पहले अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
e: New Development Bank (NDB) ke pehle adhyaksh K. V. Kamath the, isliye yahi sahi nam hai. Yah bank BRICS deshon ne 2014 mein banaya tha tatha iska daftar Shanghai mein hai; isliye iske pehle adhyaksh bharat ke ek prakhyat banker ko banaya gaya, jisse naye kosh tatha chunauti bhare samay mein bank ko sahi disha mile. N. K. Singh ek adhikari the, Raghuram Rajan tatha Urjit Patel Reserve Bank ke gavarnar rahe hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: NDB ke pehle adhyaksh K. V. Kamath the - yahi bank BRICS deshon ne 2014 mein khada kiya tha.

qe: Which arm of the World Bank Group provides political risk insurance and credit enhancement to cross-border investors?
qh: विश्व बैंक समूह की कौन सी शाखा निवेशकों को राजनीतिक जोखिम बीमा (गारंटी) प्रदान करती है?
e: World Bank samuh ki shakha MIGA niveshkon ko rajnaitik jokhim ka bima (guarantee) deti hai, isliye yahi sahi nam hai. Yah suvidha isliye zaroori thi ki badalte sarkaron, yuddh ya sampatti jabat hone par bade nivesh doob sakte the; isliye MIGA guarantee dekar aisi bhagidari ko bachati hai tatha garib deshon mein factory tatha bijli ke pariyojna asani se khulte hain. IDA garib deshon ko saste karz deti hai, IFC niji companyon mein hissa lagati hai tatha IBRD sarkaron ko karz deta hai, isliye ye teeno is kam ke sahi nam nahi hain. Exam point: MIGA rajnaitik jokhim ka bima deti hai - yahi bade niveshko ko suraksha deti hai.

qe: What does the 'Most Favored Nation' (MFN) principle require under WTO agreements?
qh: व्यापार में 'मोस्ट फेवर्ड नेशन' (MFN) दर्जे का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Treating all WTO member states equally regarding customs tariffs and trade concessions
Mandating zero tariffs on all raw agricultural commodities
Giving unilateral preferences to neighboring territories exclusively
e: Mosst Favard Nation (MFN) darja ka matlab hai ki WTO ke sabhi sadasya deshon ke saath sima-shul tatha vyapar ki chhooton mein ek jaise baratav karna hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah usool isliye rakha gaya ki koi desh kisi ek dost ko khaas chhoot dekar anya deshon ko na pichhe chhod de; isliye ek sadasya ko di jane wali chhoot sabhi sadasya deshon ko mil jati hai. Kheti ki saari cheezon par shoonya tarifa lagana, angreji bolne wale deshon ko chhod dena tatha keval padosi deshon ko chhoot dena, ye teeno bayan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: MFN ka arth hai sabhi sadasya deshon ke saath ek jaise baratav - isse vyapar mein bhedbhav nahi hota.

qe: What distinguishes an 'Economic Union' from a Customs Union or Common Market?
qh: एक 'आर्थिक संघ' (Economic Union) एकीकरण के अन्य स्तरों से किस प्रकार भिन्न होता है?
o: It requires barter-based bilateral trade settlements
It establishes closed borders for capital mobility
It restricts free trade only to services
It integrates common economic policies, regulatory convergence, and often a single currency
e: Aarthik sangh (Economic Union) alag-alag deshon ki aarthik niti ka mel, niyamon ka ek jaise roop tatha aksar ek mudra istemal karta hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah sabse uncha star hai kyonki ismein vyapar tatha punji ka aana-jaana bhi khula hota hai tatha bank, kar tatha vyapar ki nitiyan bhi sanjha hoti hain; European Union iska sabse bada udaharan hai. Bartar vyapar ka bandobast, punji ke liye bandh seema tatha keval sevaon mein khuli chhoot, ye teeno vyakhyayein adhuri hain. Exam point: aarthik sangh mein niti, niyam tatha mudra tak ek ho jaate hain - yahi ekikaran ka sabse uncha star hai.

qe: The economic grouping 'Asian Tigers' historically achieved rapid modernization through:
qh: 'एशियन टाइगर्स' (Asian Tigers) ने मुख्य रूप से किसके माध्यम से तेजी से विकास हासिल किया?
o: Complete disengagement from global technology transfers
Strict autarky and closed-door import prohibition
Aggressive export-oriented industrialization and integration with world markets
Exclusive reliance on agrarian subsistence output
e: Eshiyan Tigers ne bahirdeshiya niryat (export-oriented industrialization) tatha vaishvik bazar se judne ke raste tezi se vikas paya, isliye yahi sahi karan hai. Yah chunav isliye kam aya ki chhote deshon ka gharelu bazar kamzor tha; isliye unho ne nivesh ki suvidha tatha sasta parishram se bade deshon ko mall banakar becha, jisse kamai tatha naye kaam-dhandhe tezi se badhte gaye. Teknoloji se poori tarah duur rahna, bandh darwazon ki niti tatha keval samuha ke hatho ke bharose rahna, ye teeno vikas ke raste nahi hote. Exam point: Asian Tigers ne niryat par tike udyog tatha vaishvik bazar se judkar vikas paya - isliye unhe tiger kaha gaya.

qe: In global finance, what is meant by the 'Contagion Effect'?
qh: वैश्विक अर्थशास्त्र में 'कॉन्टैगियन इफेक्ट' (Contagion Effect) का क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: The rapid cross-border spread of financial shocks and capital flight across linked markets
A systematic drop in maritime shipping tariffs
The international transmission of biological pathogens through air cargo
The simultaneous default of all international trade organizations
e: Contagion Effect ka matlab hai ek hi bazar mein ai' girkar jaisi dhakke ka jude huye doosre bazaron mein tezi se phailna tatha punji ka bhag khaali hona, isliye pehli vyakhya sahi hai. Yah bhram isliye banti hai ki aaj sabhi desh bade bankon tatha koshon se jude hain tatha ek desh ka karz doosre desh ke niveshko ko bhi gher leta hai; isliye 1997 ke eshiyai sankat tatha 2008 ke vaishvik sankat mein asar padosi bazaron tak pahunch gaya. Samudri bhade ka girta, hawai jahaz se keet ya virus ka phailna tatha sabhi vyapari sansthaon ka ek saath diwala nikalna, ye teeno galat bayan hain. Exam point: Contagion Effect ek bazar ke jhatke ka doosre bazaron mein phailna hai - isliye karkat sankat se sabhi ko bachna padta hai.

qe: What macro-level vulnerability precipitated the 1997 East Asian Financial Crisis?
qh: 1990 के दशक के अंत में दक्षिण पूर्व एशियाई वित्तीय संकट का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: Rapid deflation in world commodity demand exclusively
A complete lack of export industries
A total prohibition on commercial bank lending
Maintaining de facto fixed exchange pegs alongside unrestricted short-term foreign capital inflows
e: 1990 ke dashak ke ant ka dakshin-purv eshiyai sankat ka mukhya karan tha sthira vinimay dar banaye rakhna tatha bina kisi rok ke chhoti avadhi ka videshi punji aane dena, isliye yahi sahi karan hai. Yah vyavastha isliye tooti ki jis desh ne apni mudra ko kisi doosri mudra se baandh diya ho, wahan par niveshko ke ek saath paisa nilkalne par mudra tatha bank dono bikhar jaate hain; isliye Thai Baht tatha Korean Won ke girte hi pura kshetra doob gaya. Vaishvik vastu maang ka girta, niryat ka bilkul na hona tatha vyaparik bankon ko karz dena par poori rok, ye teeno us sankat ke karan nahi the. Exam point: 1997 ka sankat sthira mudra aur chhoti avadhi ke videshi punji ke mel se badha - iske baad eshiyai deshon ne bhandar badhaye.

qe: What was the initial financial catalyst of the 2007-2008 Global Financial Crisis?
qh: 2008 के वैश्विक वित्तीय संकट की मुख्य शुरुआत किससे हुई थी?
o: The total cessation of petroleum trade through the Strait of Hormuz
A coordinated worldwide increase in corporate tax rates
A severe crop failure in Western Europe
Mass defaults on US sub-prime mortgages and the collapse of mortgage-backed structured securities
e: 2008 ke vaishvik vitti sankat ki shuruat America ke sub-prime (kam yogyata wale) ghar ke karjon ke bade pamane par diwala tatha unke se judi securities ke girne se hui thi, isliye yahi sahi karan hai. Yah sankat isliye bhayankar bana ki bade bankon ne yah kaarz aage bech diye the tatha poore vishw ke kosh unmein nivesh kiye hue the, isliye ek hi jhatke se duniya bhar ka bank tatha vyapar ruk gaya. Hormuz ki khadi se tel vyapar ka bandh hona, kampani kar ki dar badhana tatha pashchim Europe mein fasal kharab hona, ye teeno alag ghatnaen hain. Exam point: 2008 ka sankat America ke sub-prime gharon ke karz se shuru hua - isliye usay global financial crisis kaha jaata hai.

qe: In WTO agricultural trade negotiations, which 'Box' contains domestic support measures that are deemed trade-distorting and subject to reduction limits?
qh: WTO कृषि समझौते में, कौन सा 'बॉक्स' व्यापार-विकृत करने वाली और कटौती योग्य सब्सिडी को रखता है?
e: WTO kheti samjhauta ke tahat Amber Box mein ve karz-mukt tatha mazdoori par tike subsidies aate hain jo vyapar ko bigati hain tatha jinhe kam karna padta hai, isliye yahi sahi nam hai. Yah baks isliye sabse kaathin hai ki 'Total AMS' naam se har desh ki kul aisi subsidy ki seema tay hoti hai; isliye ise laal box ki tarah poori tarah band nahi kiya gaya balki dhire-dhire kam karvaya jaata hai. Red Box aisa koi baks nahi hai, Blue Box ke payments kam karne wale karyakramon se jude hain tatha Green Box ki subsidy se vyapar par asar nahi padta, isliye baaki teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: vyapar ko bigane wali tatha kam karni wali subsidy Amber Box mein hoti hai - isi liye ise sabse kaathin baks kaha jaata hai.

qe: Agricultural subsidies designated under the WTO 'Green Box' are exempted from reduction commitments because they:
qh: कृषि में 'ग्रीन बॉक्स' सब्सिडी को कटौती से छूट क्यों दी गई है?
o: Apply exclusively to tropical plantation crops
Cause minimal or no trade distortion and are decoupled from current production levels
Are paid entirely in foreign currency reserves
e: Green Box subsidy ko chhoot isliye mili hai ki isse vyapar par kam ya bilkul asar nahi padta tatha yah aaj ke utpadan se judi nahi hoti, isliye yahi sahi karan hai. Aise payments mein vaigyanik adhyayan, bimari se bachav, gaon ki sadak tatha paryavaran ke program aate hain; isliye ise vyapar ko bigaadne wali subsidy nahi mana jaata tatha ise kam karne ki badhya ka nahi hoti. Keval samudri kheti par laagu hona, vyapar chhooton se juda hona tatha poora videshi mudra mein diya jana, ye teeno iske matlab nahi hain. Exam point: Green Box ko chhoot isliye hai ki ismein vyapar ko bigaadne wali koi baat nahi hoti - isliye yah subsidy kam karne se bahar hai.

qe: Under the WTO General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS), what does 'Mode 1' supply entail?
qh: GATS के तहत सेवाओं के व्यापार में 'मोड 1' (Mode 1) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Establishing a commercial banking subsidiary abroad
A consumer physically traveling to another state to receive medical treatment
A software engineer traveling on a temporary work visa abroad
Cross-border supply where the service crosses national frontiers while provider and user stay in their home countries
e: GATS ke tahat Mode 1 ka matlab hai seema ke par seva (cross-border supply) - yani seva seema par jati hai jabki dene wala tatha lene wala dono apne desh mein rahte hain, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Iska sabse sahaj udaharan hai videshi grahak ko call centre ya online software ki seva bharat se dena; isliye 1990 ke dashak ke baad IT tatha BPO ka karyakram isi mode par tezi se badha. Videsh mein bank ki shakha kholna Mode 3 hai, ilaj ke liye doosre desh jana Mode 2 hai tatha kaam ke liye doctor ya engineer jana Mode 4 hai, isliye baaki teenon ka mel nahi baithta. Exam point: GATS ka Mode 1 seema ke par ki seva hai - ismein seva seema par jati hai, log nahi.

qe: What is the 'Special Safeguard Mechanism' (SSM) sought by agricultural developing nations at the WTO?
qh: विकासशील देशों द्वारा WTO में मांगा जाने वाला 'स्पेशल सेफगार्ड मैकेनिज्म' (SSM) क्या है?
o: A mechanism to temporarily raise tariffs to shield smallholder farmers from import surges or price plunges
A permanent embargo on processed food imports
An export subsidy for low-income farmers
A credit guarantee for cross-border grain procurement
e: WTO mein vikasshil deshon dwara manga jane wala Special Safeguard Mechanism (SSM) aisa upay hai jo ayatan mein achanak badhotari ya dam girne par kuchh samay ke liye tarifa badhakar chhote kisaanon ko bachata hai, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah demand isliye utthi ki kholi kheti ki cheezein jab bahut saste dam par aane lagti hain to gharelu kisaan berozgar ho jaate hain; isliye aise karan ke liye ek suraksha vaalve chahiye thi. Processed bhojan par hamesha ke liye bandh, garib kisaanon ke liye niryat subsidy tatha anaaj kharidne ki karz guarantee, ye teeno SSM nahi hain. Exam point: SSM ayatan ke jhatke par ashtai tarifa badhane ka upay hai - isse chhote kisaan bachte hain.

qe: Under GATS classifications, 'Mode 4' trade in services refers to:
qh: GATS वर्गीकरण के तहत, 'मोड 4' सेवा व्यापार किससे संबंधित है?
o: Cross-border pipeline delivery of refined fuels
Foreign investment in retail chain infrastructure
Temporary international movement of natural persons supplying professional services
e: GATS ke vargikaran mein Mode 4 ka matlab hai vyavasaik seva dene wale vyaktiyon ka doosre desh mein ashtai roop se jana, isliye yahi sahi kam hai. Yah mode isliye mahatvapurn hai ki doctor, engineer, teacher tatha chef jaise log kuchh mahinon ke liye doosre desh mein kaam karne jaate hain; isliye deshon ke beech visa tatha licence ke niyam tay karne ke liye yah alag shreni banai gayi. Sima ke par pipe se tel bhejna Mode 1 ki bhanti hai, videsh mein chain ke liye nivesh Mode 3 hai tatha online data hosting Mode 1 ka hissa hai, isliye baaki teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: GATS ka Mode 4 vyaktiyon ke ashtai pravasan se juda hai - ismein seva dene wala khud doosre desh jata hai.

qe: Agricultural supports classified in the WTO 'Blue Box' represent:
qh: WTO कृषि समझौते में 'ब्लू बॉक्स' (Blue Box) सब्सिडी का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Subsidies granted strictly for oceanic aquaculture
Subsidies completely barred under international trade dispute mechanisms
Amber Box-type production-linked payments conditioned on mandatory production-limiting programs
Export credits issued directly by national central banks
e: WTO kheti samjhauta mein Blue Box un karz-sambandhi bhugtanon ko kaha jaata hai jo utpadan seemit karne wale karyakramon ki shart par diye jaate hain, isliye yahi sahi vyakhya hai. Yah baks isliye banaya gaya ki kuchh desh apni fasal seemit karne ke badle kisaanon ko paisa dete the; isliye ise Amber Box se alag mankar kam karne ki badhya se bahar rakha gaya. Samudri palan ki subsidy, vivad nirnay se poori tarah bandh subsidy tatha kendriya bankon ke niryat credit, ye teeno Blue Box ke matlab nahi hain. Exam point: utpadan seemit karne wale bhugtan Blue Box mein aate hain - isi liye unhe kam karne ki badhya nahi hoti.
